classification.difficultyReason: Use the fixed height to find three whole-number factor pairs for the base dimensions.

content.prompt: A right rectangular prism has volume $450\text{ mm}^3$. The height of the prism is $10\text{ mm}$. Give three sets of whole number dimensions for such a prism.

answer.short:
$5\text{ mm}\times9\text{ mm}\times10\text{ mm}$; $15\text{ mm}\times3\text{ mm}\times10\text{ mm}$; $45\text{ mm}\times1\text{ mm}\times10\text{ mm}$.

The two base dimensions must multiply to $45\text{ mm}^2$.
